notes.title: Major update and the end of early access!
notes.notes:
[p]🫡The game is out of early access! Thank you all for your support and participation in the development! We have tried to take into account all your wishes!

📃List of changes:

💡A new map
💡A new enemy
💡Bug fixes
💡Balance adjustments
💡In-game text chat
💡Improved performance

💌Please continue to report problems to us - the future of the game depends on you! We hope you enjoy the new content and have fun![/p]

notes.title: RANKED GAMES ARE BACK!
notes.notes:
🏆 We finally finished making a new system for ranked games! We hope you will like it! And now you also can play against your friends if you want!

‼️ Ranked games may still have some bugs, so we hope for your reports so we can fix everything fast enough!

🔆 We also did some fixes and updated the tutorial as many of you asked!

notes.title: Ranked games are available in beta!
notes.notes:
🕖We made a special version for ranked games testing. We did this to fix all possible errors before the release!

💻The new version is available for everyone in the game version selection.

🫵🏻We need your help, hope for feedback!

⭕️You can also play with friends and against friends if you can't find a server!

notes.title: More bug fixes!
notes.notes:
We fixed some bugs and also fixed a problem where, in one spell, you could create more than one object!

The ranked games are also on their way! Wait a bit more, please!

notes.title: A small performance update.
notes.notes: We published a small performance update, the game should work smoother now!

notes.title: Damage fix
notes.notes:
Sorry guys, it seems after the last update, we kind of made the character immortal to npc!

Fixed!

notes.title: Some fixes, friendly fire, and summon limit updates.
notes.notes:
☠️Now, the friendly fire is 25% of normal damage, except for healing.

👽You can also now summon only 15 nps and 1 healing mushroom.

⭕️Also did some small fixes. 

Thank you all for your reports! We are still working on bringing back the ranked games and fixing the servers!

notes.title: Bug fixes and ranked games disabling.
notes.notes:
Thank you all for your attention and reports.

We fixed some bugs and temporarily disabled the ranked system. It has too mush problems and we just can't leave it in the game in that state. We are working on it. 

One more reason to disable it is the problem with the server-finding system, which we are still working on. But now, friend invites are working, so you can play with your friends even if you don't see their server.

We are doing our best to fix all the problems!

notes.title: Joining via Steam friends list.
notes.notes:
Now you can join your friends via the Steam friends list!

We still haven't fixed the server visibility issue, but now if you can't see your friend's server, you can join it through your friends list.

notes.title: Fixing game crashes!
notes.notes:
We tried to fix the problems with game crashes!

Now everything should work better! 
We hope to hear your feedback on the results!

We are also aware of issues with server visibility in different regions, we are working on this.

Remember that the game is in early access and bugs are possible! We are doing everything possible to fix the problems!

notes.title: The game is out in early access!
notes.notes:
🎁Thank you all for your support.

👀Play, enjoy, leave feedback, and submit bug reports! 

🫵Remember, the game is still in development, and its future depends on you!

💻Visit us on Discord if you want to follow and participate in the development process!
